current_suggestion.pitch: Alex Wahl covers high-level GTO concepts with a focus on the intuition behind solver outputs — bridging the gap between raw GTO Wizard data and actual in-game reasoning in a way your current poker channels (GTO Wizard, GTO Lab, Jared Alderman) don't always prioritize. His content tends to be solo or small-group format, working through hands and concepts methodically rather than results-oriented recaps. If you value understanding *why* the solver does what it does rather than just memorizing frequencies, his angle complements what you're already watching.
